build_deferred_tool_registry: build a DeferredToolRegistry to store and search deferred LangChain tools by regex patterns
create_tool_search_query: create a tool_search call to fetch full schema definitions for deferred tools matching a query
register_tool_in_registry: register a LangChain BaseTool into a DeferredToolRegistry for deferred discovery
search_deferred_tools: search deferred tools by exact name, keyword, or regex pattern against name and description
promote_deferred_tools: promote matched deferred tools so they pass through the filter middleware as active
